model_cost.allowance_basis: 587 one-per-sink replicas plus retaining both mapped roots; sizing allowance, not measured clone count. Any extra buffers/replicas must be captured from actual flow; no fit/signoff inferred.
model_cost.basis: Flow-only correction in existing full64tile model; all original mapped cells unchanged. DC ties add no arithmetic/latency cycles, no rate credit.

native_scope: Netlist import and ordinary tie-output/special PG connectivity only; no floorplan, route, PG geometry or SS/FF timing qualification. Loaded SS/WC and FF/BC libraries from original route log; serialized technology/master LEF from original synthesized ODB.
physical_build_scope: User-authorized single fresh characterization for flow-error correction; only tied guarded netlist substituted. Driver/hooks/RTL byteidentical e3 baseline; no host resynthesis, ABC, dff remap or timing tuning.
